The quasiparticle lifetime is set by the level width,
\begin{equation}
\tau \equiv \frac{\hbar}{\Gamma} .
\label{eq:life}
\end{equation}
In the Matsubara formalism we need the elementary imaginary-time integral
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\beta} d\tau\, e^{\tau\epsilon} = \frac{e^{\beta\epsilon}-1}{\epsilon} .
\label{eq:tau}
\end{equation}
